source.title: Mod p points on Shimura varieties of parahoric level
source.authors: Pol van Hoften, with Appendix A by Rong Zhou
source.version: Published67-page version, acquired2026-09-22. arXivv4 is an earlier78-page near-final comparison source.

summary: van Hoften describes the mod p points of Shimura varieties of Hodge type at parahoric level: isogeny classes via restricted local shtukas and affine Deligne–Lusztig varieties, CM lifts of every isogeny class, and connected components of EKOR strata, with Appendix A (with Zhou) on connected components of ADLVs in the non-basic case. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and thirty-four findings are recorded. After review, ten slips affect nothing; the §2.1 perfect-space arguments, the Hoff23 import (E33) and several appendix steps have recorded proof gaps, and E17 affects a stated result. Not formalised.

hypotheses.H: H: (G,X) is Hodge type, p>2, G_Qp is quasi-split and splits tamely, p does not divide |pi1(Gder)|, pi1(G)_I is torsion-free; levels away from p are sufficiently small. Use connected full facet stabilizers. Set mu=sigma(mu_h^(-1)) and k=Fpbar.
hypotheses.V: V: G/Qp is connected reductive and quasi-split, K is a sigma-stable very special parahoric, mu is dominant and [b] belongs to B(G,mu); no global Shimura hypotheses unless explicitly added.

structure DividedPowers where
  /-- The divided power function underlying a divided power structure -/
  dpow : ℕ → A → A
  dpow_null : ∀ {n x} (_ : x ∉ I), dpow n x = 0
  dpow_zero : ∀ {x} (_ : x ∈ I), dpow 0 x = 1
  dpow_one : ∀ {x} (_ : x ∈ I), dpow 1 x = x
  dpow_mem : ∀ {n x} (_ : n ≠ 0) (_ : x ∈ I), dpow n x ∈ I
  dpow_add : ∀ {n} {x y} (_ : x ∈ I) (_ : y ∈ I),
    dpow n (x + y) = (antidiagonal n).sum fun k ↦ dpow k.1 x * dpow k.2 y
  dpow_mul : ∀ {n} {a : A} {x} (_ : x ∈ I),
    dpow n (a * x) = a ^ n * dpow n x
  mul_dpow : ∀ {m n} {x} (_ : x ∈ I),
    dpow m x * dpow n x = choose (m + n) m * dpow (m + n) x
  dpow_comp : ∀ {m n x} (_ : n ≠ 0) (_ : x ∈ I),
    dpow m (dpow n x) = uniformBell m n * dpow (m * n) x

variable (A) in
/-- The canonical `DividedPowers` structure on the zero ideal -/
